title: NPI test vectors
description: Deterministic fixture of National Provider Identifier candidates paired with category labels and validation verdicts. Designed to exercise the CMS Luhn-with-80840-prefix checksum algorithm in downstream Swift tests.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the format changes in a way that requires a Swift-side decoder update.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

seed.description: PRNG seed used to generate this artifact, recorded for reproducibility.

vectors.description: Test vectors. Each record is one NPI candidate with its expected classification.

npi.description: NPI candidate as a digit string. Length is category-dependent: 10 for most categories, other lengths for invalid_length.

valid.description: Whether the NPI passes all NPI structural checks (prefix 1 or 2, 10 digits, CMS Luhn).

category.description: Which detector edge case this vector exercises.

expected_luhn_remainder.description: The remainder returned by cms_luhn(npi). Zero for valid NPIs; nonzero for invalid_checksum rows.

reason.description: Human note describing why this vector was included.
